slides.texte_overlay:
how to unlock 100% of
your brain
Get bored on purpose. Ten minutes without input, just thinking. Boredom is when your brain connects ideas and comes up with new ones.
Learn with your hands. Draw, build, cook, play an instrument. Using your hands activates your brain in ways that reading alone never does.
Switch subjects during the day. An hour of work, then a walk, then something creative. Variety keeps your brain fresh instead of drained.
Drink water before coffee. Many people feel foggy simply because they're dehydrated. A big glass of water in the morning clears your head.
Before: my brain only got short videos. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I feel sharper and more curious every week.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my brain only got short videos. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I feel sharper and more curious every week.

slides.texte_overlay: Spend time with smart people. Conversations with curious friends stretch your thinking more than any book. Seek them out and ask good questions.
Test yourself instead of rereading. Close the book and try to explain what you just learned. Recalling builds memory far better than rereading.
